Welcome to THE WREN
A fantastic, vibrant school at the heart of its community
At The Wren, we challenge ourselves to become better day by day: driving our school community forward so that we can offer our students an exceptional education. We are not a school that will sit still. We are restless and will be bold. We share an ambitious and inspirational vision which motivates us, and our students, to be the best we can be, ensuring that;
‘Each child, regardless of background will receive a world-class education and be nurtured, challenged and inspired to aim high.’
Our rich and purposeful curriculum offers an extensive blend of academic and practical opportunities which challenge and inspire our students to explore, discover and learn new things. We have a relentless focus on Quality First Teaching and Learning, with an exceptional team who are committed to creating ‘Inspirational Classrooms.’ To facilitate this, we expect and encourage the highest standards of attitude, behaviour and commitment from staff and students alike.
As a school we value community cohesion and work closely in partnership with the Excalibur Academies Trust and its excellent network of schools. We encourage you, as families, students, and the local community, to fully invest in life at The Wren as the successful academic and personal growth of every student, relies on the investment and dedication of us all.
I hope you are inspired by what you read and see, and encourage you to visit us, speak with us and then join us on our journey to exceptional.
John Salberg Principal

pageCache.pageTitle: Year 11 GCSE Achievements: Celebrating Character and Progress - The Wren
pageCache.text:
Year 11 GCSE Achievements: Celebrating Character and Progress
The whole community at The Wren is today celebrating the hard work, determination, and personal achievements of its Year 11 students as they receive their GCSE and Level 2 vocational results.
Today is a celebration of growth and individual progress. Reflecting the school’s core values of Kindness, Ambition, and Respect, this exceptional group of students has demonstrated grit and determination throughout their secondary education, maintaining the school’s strong progress trajectories—proving that hard work and high expectations deliver meaningful learning gains across all subjects.
In line with The Wren’s ethos that “Better Never Stops,” the 2026 results highlight the value added by excellent teaching, bespoke academic intervention, and strong pastoral care. Across the full range of subjects, students have achieved outcomes that reflect consistent progress from their individual starting points, ensuring they are well-prepared for their next steps in education and training.
John Salberg, Principal of The Wren, said:
“Today is entirely about our students—their character, their sustained effort, and the personal milestones they have achieved. Every cohort is unique, and this group of young people has shown great ambition and commitment to their learning.
“When we look at individual student progress from where they began their journey, we see real success stories, whether that is a set of grade 9s and 8s, achieving a grade 4 in Maths or English, there is success to celebrate everywhere we look. We are not just celebrating grades today; we are celebrating the growth, maturity, and resilience of the young adults standing before us. They have earned their success, and our entire school community is immensely proud of them.”
Looking Ahead to Next Steps
The true measure of today’s success lies in progression. The majority of Year 11 students have secured the qualifications needed to move seamlessly into their chosen post-16 pathways. Many will continue their educational journey at Wren Six, taking advantage of the school’s expanding A-Level and Vocational provision, while others move on to local college courses, specialist vocational training, and apprenticeships.
The success of our students is made possible through the unwavering dedication of our teaching and support staff, as well as the continued partnership with our families and the wider Wren community.
We wish all of our Year 11 leavers the very best and every success as they step into their bright futures.

Vision and Values
Our Vision
This is what we want from our school…
‘Each child, regardless of background will receive a world-class education and be nurtured, challenged and inspired to aim high.’
Our Mission
This is how we are going to get there…
Nurture
We will have an ambitious culture of student inclusivity that ensures every child is well known, where all students receive an exceptional level of support and where wellbeing is at the heart of our provision.
Challenge
We will offer an ambitious, inclusive and diverse curriculum that promotes resilience and curiosity. We will challenge all students to embrace and adopt a Better Never Stops mindset to ensure they make exceptional progress and become the best version of themselves.
Inspire
We will create an inspirational school environment rooted in exceptional teaching and learning where students have high expectations and ambitions and aspire to have remarkable futures.
Our Values
This is what we believe and what will guide every interaction…
Kindness
We expect all members of our community to be kind and considerate, actively demonstrating kindness towards others. We will be kind in our conversations, through our attitudes and all of our decisions will be guided by having kindness at its core.
Ambition
We will be ambitious through our actions and the expectations we have for ourselves and each other. We will challenge ourselves to be the best that we can be, being ambitious in our behaviours, in our attitudes and in the learning we make.
Respect
We will create an environment of mutual respect where every member of our school community demonstrates and feels respected, where diversity and difference are celebrated and where individuals respect themselves, others, everyone’s learning and our school environment.

GCSEPOD
GCSEPOD
GCSE Pod is an awarding winning online platform, purchased by The Wren for our students, to provide free access to a vast range of revision resources for GCSE exams. Students who regularly use this platform to help with revision, achieve one grade higher on average than equivalent non-users.
Key benefits include:
Interactive and Engaging Learning Experience: GCSE Pod uses a combination of audio-visual resources, including podcasts, videos, and quizzes, to help students learn and retain information. This makes the learning experience interactive, engaging, and enjoyable, which can help to keep students motivated in their subjects;
Convenient Access to Resources: GCSE Pod can be accessed anytime, anywhere, which makes it convenient for students to use. They can access revision materials on their phone, tablet, or computer so they can fit study as they wish;
Comprehensive Coverage of Exam Topics: GCSE Pod provides revision materials for all core subjects that students study at GCSE level, including Maths, English, Science, and Humanities;
Personalised Learning: GCSE Pod allows students to track their progress and identify areas where they need more support. This enables them to focus their revision efforts on the areas where they need the most help.
